title: Glasses Case
description: A slim crochet case that protects glasses in your bag and closes with a simple button or loop.
expectationText: A compact useful project that teaches shaping by measurement and neat finishing.

steps.title: Measure the glasses
steps.instruction: Check the width and height of the glasses so the case is easy to slide on and off.

steps.title: Crochet the body
steps.instruction: Work a rectangle long enough to fold into a pouch with a little flap.

steps.title: Fold and check size
steps.instruction: Wrap the rectangle around the glasses and confirm the fit before joining.

steps.title: Seam the edges
steps.instruction: Join the sides neatly so the glasses stay protected and the case keeps its shape.

steps.title: Add the closure
steps.instruction: Crochet a loop or small buttonhole and pair it with a button if you want extra security.

steps.title: Finish the case
steps.instruction: Weave in ends and test the opening a few times so the case feels smooth to use.
